WoW: Forever

Demonology Warlock

Your demon fights alongside you and your own damage keeps it alive. In Forever, demons scale with your gear.

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Demonology build has been tested. No source has posted a level 30 build either — the cap only reached 30 on October 1 and none of the three has published one since — so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended.

What Demonology is for

Demonic EnergiesDemonic EnergiesTalentCastInstantYou heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.: your damage heals the demon, and Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · ShadowCastInstant feeds its mana. At 2/2, 15% of all your spell damage is mirrored to your pet as healing and 100% of the mana from a Life Tap goes to it as well, so the thing absorbing the hits is topped up by the casting and the resource management you were doing anyway.

"Demonology is an excellent solo leveler because your demon can take a lot of pressure off you while you cast from range." Icy Veins rates its levelling 5 out of 5, joint best in the class.

One cost, in the source's own words: "Unlike Affliction, this build does not take Improved CorruptionImproved CorruptionTalentCastInstant, so CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · ShadowCast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 sec still has a cast time", which means "setting up multiple enemies takes longer than it does for Affliction."

ClassicWoW.gg does not publish a suggested build for any spec, by design.

The Legacy System adds points beyond these 11. Wowhead puts the cap at 7 legacy points from world exploration before level 25, worth 2 extra talent points. Its top pick there is Improved SayaadImproved SayaadTalentCastInstantIncreases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 30%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%., "the strongest per point benefit" for Succubus damage; it calls Demonic SacrificeDemonic SacrificeSpell · ShadowCastInstantRange100 yd range "likely not worth it due to losing out on your pet's DPS" this early. Those points cannot be spent at 20 as printed. Blizzard's Known Issues list opening the Legacy System before level 25 as a bug — the “Y” hotkey works and throws LUA errors on tabs 1 and 3 — so read these as what to spend Legacy points on from 25, not as part of a level-20 build.

Rotation

Icy Veins and Wowhead order the opening DoTs differently, same as the other two specs.

Icy Veins' order is Immolate, then Corruption, then Bane of Agony.

Wowhead reverses it: "Bane of Agony first: it deals the least upfront damage, so it's the least threat and requires time to build up to full damage. Immolate last; its initial Hit generates direct threat, so it's the worst opener."

  1. Send the demon in: "Your demon should be attacking throughout the entire fight"
  2. Curse
  3. ImmolateImmolateLevel 1 · Spell · FireCast2 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration15 sec: or last, on Wowhead's threat-ordered build, see above
  4. CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · ShadowCast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 sec: it has a cast time in this build
  5. Bane of AgonyBane of AgonyLevel 8 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration24 sec if the target will live long enough: or first, on Wowhead's build
  6. Drain LifeDrain LifeLevel 14 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantCost55 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration5 sec when you need health. "The spell damage will also heal your demon through Demonic EnergiesDemonic EnergiesTalentCastInstantYou heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain."
  7. Wand as filler at level 20
  8. Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · ShadowCastInstant when you need mana: "With Demonic EnergiesDemonic EnergiesTalentCastInstantYou heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain., this will also restore Mana to your demon"
  9. Drain SoulDrain SoulLevel 10 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantCost55 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration15 sec for shards

Multi-target: spread CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · ShadowCast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 sec and Bane of AgonyBane of AgonyLevel 8 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration24 sec while the demon holds the pack, then Rain of FireRain of FireLevel 20 · Spell · FireCastInstantCost295 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration8 sec.

Stat priority

Spell Power, then Hit, Intellect, Spirit, critical strike, Stamina, Haste.

Same order as Affliction, different reasoning at two places. Spell Power because "More spell damage also means more healing for your demon through Demonic EnergiesDemonic EnergiesTalentCastInstantYou heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.." Hit is flagged harder: "This build does not take SuppressionSuppressionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%., so you do not have the additional Hit Chance from the Affliction tree." Intellect is lifted by Fel VitalityFel VitalityTalentCastInstantIncreases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.'s +15% maximum mana.

A stated limitation: "Demon scaling also needs additional testing to determine exactly how each of your stats affects your active demon."

Your demon

Same unlocks as every Warlock — Imp 2, VoidwalkerVoidwalkerSpell · ShadowCastInstantCost32 ManaCooldown20 sec cooldownDuration180 sec 10, Succubus 20, Felhunter 30. But "Your Demonology talents make every one of them stronger, so the best choice depends on what you are doing." The Voidwalker's threat spell is TormentTormentTalentCastInstantCost20 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownTaunts the creature, increasing the chance that it will attack the Voidwalker.; Wowhead notes it is noticeably weaker until rank 2 trains at 20.

The Imp's mana problem is answered here: it "can run out of Mana quickly, but Demonic EnergiesDemonic EnergiesTalentCastInstantYou heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain. helps significantly by restoring its Mana whenever you Life Tap."

What Forever changed for Demonology

  • Demons now scale with your gear: "Warlock demons now scale with the Warlock's stats, making them deal much more damage and become much tankier."
  • Seven new talents: Demonic AegisDemonic AegisTalentCastInstantDuration12 sec, Demonic EnergiesDemonic EnergiesTalentCastInstantYou heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain., DecimationDecimationTalentCastInstant, Demonic BrandDemonic BrandTalentCastInstant, Improved FelhunterImproved FelhunterTalentCastInstant, Demonic KnowledgeDemonic KnowledgeTalentCastInstantIncreases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active., and the capstone Demonic PactDemonic PactTalentCastInstantYour Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.: "Your Demonic SacrificeDemonic SacrificeSpell · ShadowCastInstantRange100 yd range effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect." So you keep the sacrifice buff and a demon, just not the one you sacrificed. The published reaction: "At last, we can play with our pet out instead of sacrificing it."
  • Demonic SacrificeDemonic SacrificeSpell · ShadowCastInstantRange100 yd range lasts 2 hours (Classic: 30 minutes) and its bonuses swapped: Imp now gives +15% Shadow where Classic gave Fire, and Succubus gives +15% Fire where Classic gave Shadow.
  • Master DemonologistMaster DemonologistTalentCastInstantGrants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active. Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 10%. Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%. Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 10%. Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 10%. was rewritten: Imp gives Fire damage, Voidwalker reduces physical damage taken, Succubus gives Shadow damage, Felhunter reduces magic damage taken.
  • The tree was front-loaded: Unholy PowerUnholy PowerTalentCastInstantIncreases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 10%. 4→1, Improved Health FunnelImproved Health FunnelTalentCastInstantIncreases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 40%, reduces its health cost by 30%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 100%. At level 60

Unknown, and the gap is pet scaling: "Pet balance is one of the clearest areas to watch during beta… Demonology is much more dependent on its active pet than it was in original Classic", and nobody has established how your stats convert into demon output.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
